svg.title: Praveen Yadav, Full Stack Developer
svg.desc: Animated hero. Praveen Yadav, full stack developer, cycles through Full Stack Developer, Mobile App Developer (Flutter), Python Developer and Competitive Programmer. Based in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India; worked at KryptoAd Company June to October 2025; pursuing an MCA at Lovely Professional University.
svg.text: Full stack developer who builds web and mobile applications with React, Flutter, and Python.
